name: bandit_camp
description: The Bandit Camp (camp/bandit_camp), the Lookout Camp, rebuilt from scratch for ROADMAP 49 (tools/blueprints/briefs/bandit_camp.md, REBUILD.md). MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. Output goes to build/rebuild/bandit_camp/out; 'build' writes the candidate build/rebuild/bandit_camp/camp/bandit_camp.nbt, 'live' the live structure/camp/bandit_camp.nbt (shipped 52.5, critic SHIP). Both go through ship.py, which adds the loot chest's LootTable and leaves the undrawn ground-layer cells out of the file.
